result.description: A benign marker sent in a parameter comes back unencoded in an HTML response, so an attacker-supplied value is rendered as markup.
result.name: Reflected cross-site scripting
result.remediation: Contextually escape every value interpolated into a response and set a Content-Security-Policy that forbids inline script.
